authenticated_bootstrap_scratch.meaning: after the complete cold reset write, the SHA-bound Boot overlay temporarily occupies this inactive-suffix interval before READY

c2d_header.meaning: a replacement generation header became visible while the immutable image and entry rows still carry generation 1

unwind_journal.meaning: a reset occurred after the journal was committed and before cleanup; the next cold generation must not replay it

destructive_predecessor.inactive_suffix: nonzero stale rows and values may remain physically present
destructive_predecessor.session_attic: a named stale sentinel remains physically present and must remain unreachable

write_order: write and read back the complete 50816-byte reset image
then write and read back the authenticated Boot-overlay scratch at [34048,37333)
bank5_reset_image.bootstrap_scratch_exception: the later Boot-overlay write may replace zeroes only at [34048,37333); it is disjoint from the canonical prefix and C2J
bank5_reset_image.journal_postcondition: all 64 bytes at [50752,50816) are zero before READY and before the first append

cold_repair.session_attic: need not be wiped; no active C2D record may reference a surviving session byte
cold_repair.bank2: complete target stage and CRC verification before READY
cold_repair.bank3: complete Session-family target stage and CRC verification before family publication
cold_repair.runtime_tuple: READY zero and family/generation non-callable before construction; exact Session family/generation published last

negative_branch.input: torn C2D header plus committed predecessor journal
required: the product retains LISP65_ERR_STDLIB_PROFILED_PRELOAD (0x25), rendered as E25 because the rejection precedes Bank-3 L65E availability
no stale handle or export is callable
forbidden: guessing cleanup from the stale journal

required: the full Bank-5 reset image is read back byte-identically before the later authenticated Boot-overlay preload
after that preload, the canonical prefix, Boot-overlay scratch and C2J are each read back against their separate authorities
Bank 2 equals the canonical static code plane after boot
Bank 3 equals the canonical Session family after boot
C2J is zero before the first append
READY is one only with Session family and generation one
the stale Session-Attic sentinel remains physically present but unreachable
a fresh persistent definition commits, calls, and leaves C2J zero

hardware_sequence: hold the exact Link-57 PRG and preload the SHA-bound immutable inputs
install and read back the destructive 50816-byte Bank-5 predecessor plus stale tuple and Attic sentinel
run once and capture the fail-closed state
reset and hold the same Link-57 PRG
install and read back the complete 50816-byte repair image, then install and read back the same immutable inputs including the disjoint Boot-overlay scratch
run once and capture READY, both Chip planes, Bank 5 and the surviving Attic sentinel
prove stale-name rejection, then define and call one fresh nullary function
capture the cleared C2J and committed header

acceptance.matrix_gate_effect: C4 closes only after the host contract and same-identity hardware receipt are both green
